text:
An upbeat middle at the desk began with your letter, and we are sad to hear that your recent experience with Aurelia Skyways left you dissatisfied because the handling of your companion animal booking did not match the standard you expected from the Companion Animal Travel Desk. We have reviewed the case in the desk ledger and confirmed that service changes were recorded, but the action taken at the airport did not stay aligned with our normal process for a calm and safe handover.

Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. When a companion animal is involved, the plan must remain clear for the traveler, the check-in team, and the operations staff, and any change should be explained before the movement takes place. In this instance, the communication flow broke down, and that is not acceptable. We are addressing the lapse through coaching and a fresh review of the handling steps used at the counter and at the gate. The goal is to prevent the same kind of confusion from reaching another traveler and pet.

Please be assured that your complaint has been entered for follow-up and that the service record will be kept with the rest of the operating notes. We also want you to know that concerns like yours are used to improve handoff discipline, crate checks, and confirmation practices across the desk. If you choose to travel again, the team will be instructed to give closer attention to the details that matter most for your companion animal and to keep you informed in plain language at each stage.

We regret the inconvenience caused and appreciate the chance to correct the matter through proper review. Companion Animal Travel Desk
